Unreached served paths are not copied; where served would fall back, the target raises: the BF16 pool ('auto': q_a_layernorm + unfolded q_b, the fused block RoPE into scratch rows + masked scatter, bmm_out, the BF16 decode), the unused block scratch allocation and its index of the FP8 path, eager / trtllm-gen decode, the unfused per-layer RoPE (_mla_rope_into / _rmsnorm_rope_batched), the un-pinned q_kv_a / q_b fallbacks, the NCCL helix exchange (_draft_helix_post_process), the un-pushed all-reduce fallback (_fused_ar_residual_norm), the eager draft logits path (logits_processor + _refine_block_logits / LiLiCorr / DFlash 2), the Triton Markov chain and the per-step Markov loop (markov_tokens_chain / markov_tokens), the eager drafter-input prep and main's _prepare_paged_latent_gen_inputs, vocab_shard_embedding / embed_tokens fallbacks of the draft embedding, the private context arena (dense or paged), the flashinfer paged append, accept-stats recording.

target_head_rows falls back to hidden_states[gather_ids] (served: super().target_head_rows); #21996's one-engine forward gathers before target_logits, so the in-place rows need the model's forward to call it.
